description: This file contains database migration scripts for upgrading vtiger CRM from version 5.0.3 to 5.0.4 RC, including schema changes, data updates, email template modifications, and notification scheduler adjustments.

methods.name: alter_picklist_tables
methods.description: Modifies picklist table columns by dropping 'sortorderid' and adding 'picklist_valueid'.

methods.name: insert_picklist_table
methods.description: Inserts a new picklist entry into 'vtiger_picklist' and populates its values.

methods.name: insert_values
methods.description: Populates picklist values and updates role associations for a given picklist.
